description: Pre-registered release goals. A release fails the gate when any arm-relative threshold is missed. Thresholds are relative, never absolute counts: an absolute number breaks the moment a task is added.
notes: current_vs_previous_success_drop_max is allowed to be small and positive: a release may trade 2 points of success for a large latency or cost win.
abstain_accuracy is measured only on unanswerable tasks and is expected to be 1.0; a single fabricated answer fails it.
groundedness is the fraction of required facts present in the retrieved context, so a high answer score on weak retrieval is visible rather than hidden.
